1.73 m2 
• Severe decline in kidney 
function; may need 
dialysis. 
• Client will have 
hypertension, anemia, 
malnutrition, altered bone 
metabolism, edema, 
metabolic acidosis, 
hypocalcemia, an elevated 
BUN and creatinine. Client 
may have uremia and 
azotemia. 
• Restrict fluids. 
• Restrict intake of 
fat, sodium, 
potassium, 
phosphorus, and 
magnesium. 
• Increase intake of 
calcium. 
• If not yet on 
dialysis, restrict 
protein. 
• If dialysis has been 
started, increase 
protein. 
5 
< 15 mL/ 
min/
